message.content:
Painting the Eiffel Tower would be a massive undertaking. Roughly:

| Item | Estimate |
|------|----------|
| Surface area (approx.) | 2 000 m² |
| Paint needed (standard exterior paint) | ~200 L per 100 m² → ~400 L total |
| Crew size | 10–15 painters (including rigging, safety, and logistics) |
| Work hours per day | 8–10 hours (weather permitting) |

With a crew of 12 working 9‑hour days, you could cover about 150 m² per day, so the job would take roughly **14–16 working days** under ideal conditions. In practice, weather delays, safety inspections, and logistical constraints could push this to **3–4 weeks** or more.
